topics.name: Operation Dispatch Trace
topics.purpose: Define the dispatch boundary from Runner/command/Trigger execution to an exact canonical operation, preserving authorization, arguments, target instance and result provenance.

semantics.operation_rule: Dispatch resolves an exact canonical operation identity.
semantics.argument_rule: Validated argument binding is recorded according to operation schema.
semantics.authority_rule: Applicable AccessCore authorization is evaluated at dispatch and cannot be inherited merely from Event payload.
semantics.caller_rule: Caller/session identity and assurance context propagate explicitly.
semantics.result_rule: Dispatch result references exact operation, target and execution.
semantics.event_rule: Events emitted by dispatch/result carry causality refs back to dispatch.
semantics.failure_rule: Unresolved/unauthorized/invalid dispatch never falls through to guessed operation.

invariants.rule: Runner definition, runner execution, individual step execution, operation dispatch and emitted Events are distinct explicit identities connected by traceable execution/causality relations.
